answers.reason: As head of the central administration, the chancellor holds a top-level university office and participates in central university bodies.
The chancellor is directly responsible for the university's budget and heads the central administration.
The chancellor is responsible for staff and holds a higher office, permitting participation in lower-level bodies affecting the university-wide plan.
Holders of a higher office at the central level may take part in the bodies below their level, such as the faculty council.
As a holder of a higher central office, the chancellor is permitted to take part in subordinate bodies like the study commission.
Because those with a higher office may take part in bodies below their level, the chancellor is permitted to participate.
